user_problem: Teams need customer interview prompts that elicit specific, permission-aware case-study material.
unique_output: A tailored interview guide plus fact-confirmation checklist, quotation-permission prompts, and follow-up evidence requests.
test_case: Given a product outcome summary, generate neutral questions that separate customer statements from company assumptions.
overlap_to_check: Market research, meeting minutes, and support-response workflows.
specific_guardrail: Neutral questions and confirmation/permission requests only; do not invent customer quotes, outcomes, permission or legal compliance.
